newsitem.title: USA: U.S. Plains fed cattle light test $67 - feedlots.
newsitem.headline: U.S. Plains fed cattle light test $67 - feedlots.

text.p: U.S. Plains feedlot cattle markets near midday Thursday sold at $67.00 in a limited test, off $1.00 from this week's sales, feedlot sources said.

About 1,200 slaughter steers that will likely grade select and choice sold in the Texas Panhandle and western Oklahoma area, which brought the week's sales near 90,000 head. There were no reported sales in Kansas.
Sales this week nearly sold out the showlist in the Texas Panhandle and western Oklahoma area and a large number of cattle in Kansas that were market-ready, the sources said.
Kansas showlists contained a number of cattle that were underfinished and could use more days on feed, they said.
Packers lowered bids to $67.00 when beef prices slid on Wednesday. The lower prices enabled packers to move a large number of beef loads.
Fed cattle prices next week were seen slipping further amid outlooks for increased supplies of market-ready cattle and a weaker tone to beef prices, the sources said.
